title: Smoky Salmon Tikka Masala
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring smoky salmon, with a romantic twist on a classic tikka masala recipe.
instructions: Mix cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, and red chili flakes in a small bowl.
Rub the spice mixture evenly over both salmon fillets.
Place the salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the salmon in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix irish butter, plain yogurt, and honey in a separate bowl.
Add the chicken broth to the bowl and mix well.
Add the pizza dough to the bowl and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the salmon tikka masala in the skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Serve the smoky salmon tikka masala with the naan or roti.
